name: agent-theater
description: A live pixel-art stage of your AI agents at work: a status line entry, /theater, and a compact pane of agents and lanes beside the chat. Works with Claude Code.

port.title: Port
port.description: Port of the Agent Theater server on 127.0.0.1. A theater already running there is reused.

autostart.title: Start the server
autostart.description: Start the theater server when a session starts and none is running. The session stops it again when it ends.

sample.title: Sample data
sample.description: Show the labelled sample simulation instead of live data.

config.title: Server config file
config.description: Optional. A config file the plugin passes to the server it starts, as --config.
